organization.summary: Recipient named in the proposal. The okcontract GitHub organization was created 2020-12-09 and has public repositories including graph, cells, abi2ui and uic. The proposal says the existing source package for the Onchain Risk Map is private, and a public preview is at map.okcontract.com.

claims.claim: A public preview exists at map.okcontract.com.
claims.method: The URL resolves and its page title is Onchain Attack Map. The page text fetched was only the title, because it appears to render client-side. The page loading is not proof of capability, and the contents were not reviewed.

claims.claim: The existing source package (typed topology, incident annotations, catalog validation, deterministic generators) is private.
claims.method: Applicant statement. No public repository with that name was found among the organization's public repositories listed by the GitHub API (21 public repositories, none named for the risk map). A private repository cannot be seen.
